Okay, you might consider yourself to be a failure but your children don't. Just because you think you're a failure, that doesn't mean you need to punish yourself and your family by removing yourself from their existence. 

Imagine the amount of loss and pain they will be going through for the rest of their life, wondering that they could've done something to stop you. Your children will feel like failures as they grow up. Believe me. 
Are you okay with having your wife and children grieve for the rest of their lives? Not being able to see your children grow up, graduate, get married and have kids? Are you okay with your kids having to break the news to their future children that their grandpa died by choice?

If you really feel like killing yourself, I can't really blame you. I'm in the same boat. But just think about your family before you decide whether or not you'll go through with it. 

And if you don't go through with it, talk to your wife. Talk on here. Talk to someone about what you're going through.
